description: Source code implementing a CTR_DRBG (Counter mode Deterministic Random Byte Generator) based on AES, including functions for initialization, reseeding, generation, and cleanup.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new CTR_DRBG state with provided entropy and optional personalization.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_init
methods.description: Initializes the CTR_DRBG state with entropy and personalization data.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_reseed
methods.description: Reseeds the CTR_DRBG with new entropy and optional additional data.

methods.name: CTR_DRBG_generate
methods.description: Generates pseudorandom bytes, optionally incorporating additional data.
